function.name: mv
function.description: This tool belongs to the Gorilla file system. It is a simple file system that allows users to perform basic file operations such as navigating directories, creating files and directories, reading and writing to files, etc. Tool description: Move a file or directory from one location to another. result.description: The result of the move operation.

function.name: tail
